target_customer: Gym going consumers who want strength training plans, paying an app subscription
problem: Lifters did not know what weights, sets and reps to do to keep progressing and personal trainers were expensive.
product_category: Consumer fitness app, AI workout planning

founders.name: Jake Mor
founders.background_notes: Built the product from a workout data set collected for his earlier app.

technical_complexity.rationale: A recommendation algorithm on a large lifting data set, plus mobile apps; the data set was the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Workout data compounds with users, but competing apps such as Fitbod offered similar planning.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying it. The app still operates under FitnessAI Inc. in 2026.

market_need_then: TechCrunch reported it passed 1M dollars in ARR heading into Demo Day in March 2020 while bootstrapped, which shows paying demand, and home workout interest rose that spring.

identity.visual_style: Dark gym photography with blue neon lighting, all caps headlines
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and motivational, tagline Stop Guessing. Start Progressing.

branding.community_and_virality: The press release says more than one product uses the name FitnessAI; no independent community coverage found.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic descriptive name shared with other products; the brand is carried by app store ratings claimed by the company.

outcome_analysis: FitnessAI grew an AI workout planning app to over 1 million dollars of ARR before Demo Day in March 2020 with almost no outside money, built on the founder's own lifting data set. The YC directory marks it as acquired, but no acquirer, date or price was found; the current site shows FitnessAI Inc., with a terms link pointing to Moonset Labs, which could be the buyer but is unconfirmed.
notes: CB Insights lists a seed of about 150K dated 2020-03-17 with Y Combinator, Weekend Fund and 10X Capital; only one aggregator, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Acquirer unknown; Moonset Labs link on site is a possible lead only. Competitor search returned only 2025 and 2026 review lists, so the list is empty.
